notes.subject: Aram-man i wokabaut nating
notes.rationale: ארמי אבד אבי: 'Aramean wandering/perishing was my father' — who is meant (Jacob? Laban pursuing?) and whether אובד is intransitive ('perishing') or participle of pursuit; rendered literally ambiguous.

notes.subject: papa bilong mi
notes.rationale: 'My father' = Yakov speaking for all Israel, singular ancestor for the whole people.

notes.subject: yu ken bekim na tok
notes.rationale: Ritual declaration commanded of each farmer — direct address summoning the speaker to recite.

translation: Na yu ken bekim na tok long pes bilong Yahwe, Elohim bilong yu: Aram-man i wokabaut nating i bagarap pinis, papa bilong mi; na en i go daunbilo long Mitsrayim, na en i stap bilong wanpela taim longen, wantaim ol man i no planti; na longen en i kamap bilong wanpela lain kantri, bikpela, strongpela tru, na planti man olgeta.

tokens.gloss: i wokabaut nating i bagarap pinis
